key_concepts: Cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs form systems
The human body has eleven organ systems, each with a special job
The heart pumps blood throughout the body
The circulatory system transports oxygen and nutrients and collects waste materials
The respiratory system takes in oxygen and removes carbon dioxide
The digestive system breaks down food into nutrients that cells use for energy
The muscular and skeletal systems work together to provide support, protection, and moveme
The nervous system is the body's control center and coordinates bodily activities
The excretory system filters waste products from the blood and removes extra water and was
The integumentary system includes the skin and helps regulate body temperature
Body systems are interconnected and depend on one another to function
Healthful diet and lifestyle habits promote proper functioning of body systems
